summary: This research study looks at how the liver makes sugar in people with and without type 2 diabetes and obesity. Researchers want to compare how substances called glycerol and lactate contribute to making new glucose, which is blood sugar. The trial plans to enroll 48 participants who are between 40 and 70 years old. Participants will receive infusions of different study drugs and have their blood collected for analysis.

facts.sponsor: Rutgers, The State University of New Jersey
